chapter: Learning violin and banjo in New Orleans
title: Early jobs in Polyland and on the riverfront, then leaving for Pensacola with Joe Wynn
summary: The young band plays a rough Prohibition-era place in Polyland and a foundry office during a strike, then in April 1924 Joe Wynn recruits them for Pensacola despite his mother's objections, leaving cousin Pete behind.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings
